purpose: Reviewed allowlist of every line by which the composed production Firestore Rules on gameplay/recovery-v1 differ from what production main deploys. The main gate must see exactly these changes and nothing else. Regenerate only with node tests/support/composed-production-rules.cjs --print-main-delta origin/main, then review every hunk.

candidate.base: main 186af266 plus R84-TRIM (gameplay/r84 per-save and per-read lookup trim), as regenerated by --print-main-delta origin/main: 15 hunks

hunks.why: R84-TRIM comment: reads check membership with one lookup; account liveness moves to Session start.
added: // r84 trim: reads check membership only (one lookup: the rivalry). The signed-in account document is not looked up on
// every read: no client can change it (account update is denied) and the trusted account deletion revokes the
// rivalry authority first. Account and device liveness are still checked when a Session starts.

hunks.why: R84-TRIM: currentlyEntitled no longer looks up the reader's account document (signedIn + listed in the rivalry); a stranger is still refused.
R84-TRIM: new livePairedRivalryMember = activePairedRivalry minus the two account lookups (live, active, exactly two distinct ids, reader listed).
added: // r84 trim: activePairedRivalry without the two account lookups, for reads (one lookup: the rivalry).

hunks.why: R84-TRIM comment: session read needs two lookups (the rivalry and the reader's own account).
added: // r84 trim: two lookups (the rivalry and the reader's own account, so a disabled or deletion-pending account loses its
// Session at once). The rival's account is checked when the Session starts; the session itself is resource (a missing
// one is null), not a second exists().

hunks.why: R84-TRIM: the session path variable is no longer needed (resource == null replaces exists()).

R84-TRIM: session read keeps activeActor (the reader's own account) and pair-only membership through livePairedRivalryMember; the rival's account lookup and the exists() go (two lookups instead of four).
R84-TRIM: a missing session is resource == null instead of a second exists() lookup of the same document.
R84-TRIM comment: shared reads need only the live paired rivalry that lists the reader.
added: // r84 trim: a shared read needs only the live paired rivalry that lists the signed-in account (one lookup). The two
// account documents are not looked up again: no client can change them (account update is denied), and the trusted
// account deletion first revokes the rivalry authority checked here; Session start still checks both (lazy enforcement).

hunks.why: R84-TRIM: ssjrEntitled (every Shared Journey read) uses livePairedRivalryMember: one lookup instead of three.
R84-TRIM comment: per-save write authority is rivalry + session; account and device liveness are checked at Session start.
removed: // account/device/rivalry/session facts required by this namespaced ledger
// are rechecked so the production Rules remain under Firestore's expression ceiling.
added: // rivalry/session facts required by this namespaced ledger are rechecked so the
// production Rules remain under Firestore's expression ceiling.
// r84 trim: two lookups per write (rivalry + session). The two account documents and this device's document are no longer
// looked up on every save: no client can change an account (update denied), and the trusted account deletion closes the
// account's Sessions. Both are checked when a Session starts (validOpenSessionCreate / validSessionJoin), which this write
// requires to be active, and both accounts again when a Shared Setup opens.

hunks.why: R84-TRIM: drop the per-save slot0/slot1 account and device get()s (3 lookups per save); they only stopped a modified app.
R84-TRIM: drop the conditions on those removed lookups; rivalry entitlement, membership, slots and the ACTIVE session stay.
R84-TRIM: new ssjrBothAccountsActive (both manager accounts active), used once per Showdown when the Shared Setup opens.
added: // r84 trim: both manager accounts are checked once per Showdown, when the Shared Setup is opened (plus at every Session
// start), instead of on every save: a deleted or deletion-pending account cannot start a new Showdown.

hunks.why: R84-TRIM: the Shared Setup open (create, once per Showdown) still requires both manager accounts active, so a deleted or deletion-pending account cannot start a Showdown.
R84-TRIM: the session pointer read stays pair-only through livePairedRivalryMember (one lookup instead of three).
